Theorem
[Infinite ASCR alternatives] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0109 ↗ def:chow-iii-asymptotic-ratios 1. ch19:19.23–19.24\group Asymptotic Geometry

A complete positively curved steady gradient soliton attaining its maximum scalar curvature, and a complete noncompact Type I ancient solution with bounded positive curvature operator, both have infinite ASCR. Every complete noncompact Type II ancient solution with $\Rm \ge 0$ and bounded positive sectional curvature has a backward limit which is a steady gradient soliton attaining its maximum scalar curvature.
